paper_title: SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation
reason: SSP-Bench는 안전·환각·과잉 거부·프라이버시를 영어 과제로 평가하는 동적 벤치마크 프레임워크로, 영어(en)·텍스트 트랙의 재사용 가능한 벤치마크 후보입니다. 영어 프롬프트 템플릿과 생성 항목 예시도 본문에 있습니다. 그러나 논문 각주 1은 코드와 생성된 벤치마크, 평가 스크립트가 'Anonymized URL'에 있다고만 적었고 공식 데이터셋·코드 URL은 어디에도 없습니다. 본문에 등장하는 URL은 AIAAIC 저장소, HELM Safety 리더보드, LlamaGuard·OpenAI privacy-filter 모델 카드이며 모두 SSP-Bench 자체의 공식 자원이 아닙니다. 링크 근거를 제시할 수 없으므로 행을 제안하지 않고 공식 URL이 공개된 판본을 확인한 뒤 다시 검토해야 합니다.

screening.paper_title: SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation
screening.abstract: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for safety, security, and privacy (SSP) relies heavily on static benchmarks, which suffer from score saturation, data contamination, and aggregation artifacts, and fail to capture sensitivity to linguistic variation. As a result, models that perform well on fixed test sets often fail under semantically equivalent rephrasings. We introduce SSP-Bench, a dynamic benchmarking framework that generates evaluation instances on demand while preserving domain consistency. The framework ensures label validity through externally grounded sources, enforces scope via service-specific validation, and calibrates difficulty using a multi-model steering panel. Benchmark construction is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem over difficulty, separability, novelty, and diversity. Across 24 models and four SSP services, SSP-Bench reveals systematic failures of static evaluation, including near-zero correlation in safety rankings due to construct mixing, strong safety--over-refusal coupling, and hidden within-family regressions. These results show that static benchmarks can misrepresent model behavior, motivating dynamic, deployment-relevant evaluation.
